description: mescal builds life-cycle inventories and environmental indicators for coupling to energy-system models. It maps technologies, regionalises inventories and adjusts databases to avoid double counting. The provider is matthieu-str (repository owner). Coverage: The package is generic, with a documented EnergyScope example. Geographic detail, year coverage and technology definitions depend on the source inventories and energy model. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: Code is MIT-licensed, but the workflow relies on ecoinvent and other separately licensed inventories. Their access costs are not established here. Limitations: Free software does not imply free inventory data. Independent reuse and maintenance beyond the described research tool were not established. For simulation it supplies life-cycle impact coefficients and links energy pathways to environmental assessment. Related resources: The ETI case-study mention found during name matching is unrelated text, not this mescal package.
